d616_basics.title: d616 Basics
d616_basics.description: Roll the d616 pool in Standard Die, Marvel Die, Standard Die order. Add both standard dice and the Marvel die to determine the total, treating a Marvel die result of 1 as the 6-logo and counting it as a numeric 6.

d616_roll_breakdown.title: d616 Roll Breakdown
d616_roll_breakdown.description: Record and read the dice pool as [standard_1, marvel_die, standard_2]. The Marvel die is the middle die in the pool and its 1 result is both a Fantastic trigger and a numeric 6 for the final total.

fantastic_roll.title: Fantastic Roll
fantastic_roll.description: If the Marvel die shows 1, the roll is Fantastic unless the full pool is a botch. The Marvel die still counts as 6 in the total rather than adding an extra +6 on top of its face value.

botch_ultimate_616.title: Botch and Ultimate 616
botch_ultimate_616.description: A roll of [1, 1, 1] is a botch that becomes a critical failure and overrides any other success. A roll of [6, 1, 6] is an Ultimate 616 success.

edges_troubles.title: Edges and Troubles
edges_troubles.description: Apply net Edges and Troubles to the Marvel die first. Net Edges reroll the Marvel die until it becomes 1 if possible, then reroll the lower standard die for higher results; net Troubles reroll the Marvel die first only when it is 1 to try to knock it off Fantastic, and otherwise reroll the higher standard die for lower results.
